requestwiki-label-nsfw: This wiki includes content that is not safe for work (NSFW)
requestwiki-help-nsfw: A wiki includes content that not safe for work (NSFW) if it includes graphic discussion or imagery of sex, gore or violence (either text or media content) or content which is otherwise inappropriate for those under the age of 18.
requestwiki-label-nsfwtext: Please give us more details about the type of NSFW content that your wiki will contain
requestwiki-label-nsfw-primary: This wiki primarily focuses on content that is not safe for work (NSFW)
requestwiki-help-nsfw-primary: A wiki primarily focuses on NSFW content if its main scope covers material usually marked as NSFW (a book, movies, games, etc), is a wiki where most content itself is NSFW, or otherwise focuses on content which would typically fall under an age confirmation or separation in casual settings. It does not mean cases where the wiki occasionally covers NSFW material as part of a larger work or subject.
requestwiki-label-source: This wiki is migrating or forking from an existing wiki/platform
requestwiki-label-sourceurl: Enter the full URL of the source wiki (the wiki you are moving or forking from)
sitenotice-wiki-closed: This wiki has been automatically [[meta:Dormancy Policy|closed]] because there have been no edits or log actions made within the last 120 days. If you are a bureaucrat on this wiki, you can go to [[Special:ManageWiki]] and uncheck the "Closed" box to reopen it; otherwise, if you wish for this wiki to be reopened, please request to reopen it at [[meta:Steward requests|Steward requests]]. If this wiki is not reopened within 4 months, it may be deleted.
sitenotice-wiki-closed-locked: This wiki has been closed because [[meta:Stewards|Stewards]] or [[meta:Safety|Safety]] have determined that it violates WikiOasis' [[meta:Content Policy|Content Policy]] or other global policies. Bureaucrats should have received either an email or talk page message with more information, including how to appeal.
sitenotice-wiki-closed-private: This wiki has been automatically [[meta:Dormancy Policy|closed]] because there have been no edits or log actions made within the last 120 days. If you are a bureaucrat on this wiki, you can go to [[Special:ManageWiki]] and uncheck the "Closed" box to reopen it; since the wiki is private, it cannot be reopened any other way. If this wiki is not reopened within 4 months, it may be deleted.
sitenotice-wiki-inactive: This wiki has had no edits or log actions made within the last 90 days and has been automatically marked as inactive. If you would like to prevent this wiki from being closed, please start showing signs of activity here; if you are a bureaucrat, you can go to [[Special:ManageWiki]] and uncheck "Inactive" yourself. If there are no signs of this wiki being used within the next 30 days, this wiki will be closed in accordance to the [[meta:Dormancy Policy|Dormancy Policy]] (which all wiki founders accept when requesting a wiki). If this wiki is closed and no one reopens it 150 days from now, this wiki will become eligible for deletion.
shortdescription-desc: Allows you to add short descriptions to wiki pages
embedvideo-desc: Allows you to embed videos into your pages
tiff-desc: Allows you to upload and display tiff files
mediaspoiler-desc: Allows you to add spoilers to media files on pages
pdf-desc: An easy way to upload and view PDFs on your wiki
simplebatchupload-desc: A simple way to batch upload files

wikioasis-spring-step-welcome-desc: A few questions to get the important settings right. It takes about 2-3 minutes.
wikioasis-spring-step-route: How would you like to set up?
wikioasis-spring-step-route-desc: Start from a template, or choose everything yourself.
wikioasis-spring-step-template: What sort of wiki is this?
wikioasis-spring-step-template-desc: Pick the closest match and we will apply the best settings for it.
wikioasis-spring-step-visibility-desc: This can be changed at any time afterwards.
wikioasis-spring-step-editing-desc: Choose how open editing should be. You can always adjust individual permissions later.
wikioasis-spring-step-extensions-desc: Popular choices are listed at the top, you can search for anything else.
wikioasis-spring-step-skins-desc: Skins change how your wiki looks. Pick the ones to offer and which one readers will see by default.
wikioasis-spring-step-styling-desc: Give your wiki its own look.
wikioasis-spring-step-options-desc: A few commonly used settings. Leave anything you are unsure about as it is.
wikioasis-spring-step-import-desc: Optional. Choose a set of templates and other pages to be imported into your wiki.
wikioasis-spring-step-share-desc: Your wiki is ready. Tell people it exists.
wikioasis-spring-step-finish-desc: Your wiki is ready. Here are some suitable next steps for you.
wikioasis-spring-flow-template-desc: Pick the sort of wiki you are making and we will choose sensible settings for it.
wikioasis-spring-flow-manual-desc: Go through each option and decide for yourself.
wikioasis-spring-flow-quick-desc: Set basic settings such as visibility and who can edit, the rest is left stock default.
wikioasis-spring-visibility-public-desc: Anyone can read your wiki, and search engines can index it.
wikioasis-spring-visibility-private-desc: Only members you approve can read your wiki.
wikioasis-spring-editing-anon-desc: Visitors can edit without creating an account. Best for open and public wikis.
wikioasis-spring-editing-accounts-desc: Anyone can create an account and edit. This is how many wikis work, and can help to prevent spam.
wikioasis-spring-editing-approved-desc: Only people you add to the editor group can edit. Everyone else can read.
wikioasis-spring-template-general-desc: Open to readers, editable by anyone with an account.
wikioasis-spring-template-private-desc: Readable and editable only by members you approve.
wikioasis-spring-styling-logo-help: A URL to an image, you may need to upload it first to your wiki, then come back here.
wikioasis-spring-styling-favicon-help: The small icon shown in browser tabs. Usually a square version of your logo.
wikioasis-spring-styling-wordmark-help: An image of your wiki's name, shown instead of plain text by some skins.
wikioasis-spring-styling-skin-help: The skin readers see unless they choose another in their preferences.
wikioasis-spring-next-recentchanges-desc: Recent changes shows every change to your wiki in real time.
wikioasis-spring-next-userrights-desc: Give other people permissions to help you run your wiki.
wikioasis-spring-next-managewiki-desc: Everything the wizard just set-up can be changed at Special:ManageWiki.
wikioasis-spring-template-companion-desc: A wiki about a topic with its own community off-wiki
wikioasis-spring-template-standalone-des: A wiki where the community is on the wiki
wikioasis-spring-template-standalone-bul: Extensions for article styling and discussions
wikioasis-spring-import-article-desc: Some templates and infoboxes for writing articles
wikioasis-spring-welcome-body:
Welcome to '''{{SITENAME}}''', your new wiki on WikiOasis.

This wizard helps you get started with configuring your wiki:
* who can read and edit it
* which extensions and skins it has
* what it looks like

It takes about 2-3 minutes, and everything here can be changed later at [[Special:ManageWiki]].
apihelp-wikioasisonboarding-summary: Internal module for [[Special:Welcome]]: stores survey answers, counts onboarding events, checks wiki addresses and files wiki requests.
apihelp-wikioasisonboarding-param-answer: <var>do=submit</var>: JSON object of question id to a list of option ids.
apihelp-wikioasisonboarding-param-freete: <var>do=submit</var>: JSON object of question id to free text.
apihelp-wikioasisonboarding-param-step: <var>do=event</var>: the step the event is about.
apihelp-wikioasisonboarding-param-ms: <var>do=event</var>: time spent on the step, in milliseconds.
apihelp-wikioasisonboarding-param-card: <var>do=event</var>: id of the card that was followed.
apihelp-wikioasisonboarding-param-reques: <var>do=requestwiki</var>: JSON object with the request fields.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-api-notcentral: Wikis can only be requested on the central wiki.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-login: Log in to set up your account.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-disabled: The new getting-started flow isn't available on this wiki yet.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-survey-lead-ce: Two quick questions so we send you to the right place. Nothing here is public, and you can skip it.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-survey-lead-lo: A couple of quick questions so we can suggest good places to start on {{SITENAME}}. Nothing here is public, and you can skip it.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-other-placehol: Tell us in a few words
wikioasismagic-onboarding-q-goal-central: What do you want to do on WikiOasis?
wikioasismagic-onboarding-q-goal-local: What would you like to do on {{SITENAME}}?
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-create-desc: Free, ad-free, and yours to customise. Reviewed by volunteers before it goes live.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-move-desc: Bring an existing wiki over from Fandom, Miraheze or your own server.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-edit-desc: Contribute to communities that already exist here.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-read-desc: Browse wikis without a plan yet.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-volunteer-de: Patrol, answer requests, or work on the platform.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-other-desc: Tell us in a few words.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-fix-desc: Correct typos, outdated facts and broken links.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-add-desc: Expand pages with what you know.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-write-desc: Start pages on topics that are missing.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-community-de: Join discussions and help decide where the wiki goes.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-browse-desc: Look around first and edit when something catches my eye.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-q-experience: How well do you know MediaWiki?
wikioasismagic-onboarding-q-experience-h: We'll add extra explanations if you're new.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-o-experience-n: Never edited a wiki, or only a little.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-directory: Find wikis by topic or language and start reading or editing.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-requests-: See what people are asking for and how volunteers decide.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-community: Ask questions and discuss anything that affects all wikis.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-userpage-: Your user page on Meta is shown on every WikiOasis wiki.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-preferenc: Choose a skin, dark mode and which notifications you get.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-random-de: A quick way to find something to read or improve.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-shortpage: Pages that are only a sentence or two long.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-wantedpag: Linked from other pages, but not written yet.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-upload-de: Add an image or other media to use on pages.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-community: Meet the people who run {{SITENAME}} and see what they're working on.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-help-desc: A short guide to changing a page and saving it.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-ownwiki: Want a wiki of your own?
wikioasismagic-onboarding-card-ownwiki-d: Wikis are requested on WikiOasis Meta. It only takes a few minutes.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-finish-lead-ce: Your account works on every WikiOasis wiki. Here's where to start.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-finish-lead-lo: Your account works here and on every other WikiOasis wiki. Here are some good places to start.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-finish-return: Go back to where you were
wikioasismagic-onboarding-wiki-nojs: Requesting a wiki here needs JavaScript. You can use [[Special:RequestWiki|the request form]] instead.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-wiki-blocked-t: You can't request a wiki yet
wikioasismagic-onboarding-wiki-norights: Your account isn't allowed to request wikis.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-wiki-confirmem: Confirm your email address before requesting a wiki, so reviewers can reach you. [[Special:ConfirmEmail|Confirm your email address]], then come back here.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-wiki-failed: The request couldn't be sent. Try again in a moment.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-wiki-name-lead: Pick a name and an address. You can change the name later in ManageWiki; the address is permanent unless you request a rename.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-sitename-desc: Shown at the top of every page.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-sitename-tip: It also becomes the name of the wiki's project namespace, so policy pages will live at $1.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-subdomain-desc: Lowercase letters and numbers only. Filled in from the name until you edit it.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-subdomain-tip: Want your own domain like mywiki.com? Once the wiki is live you can request one through [[Special:RequestSSL]].
wikioasismagic-onboarding-subdomain-char: Use only lowercase letters and numbers, no spaces or dashes.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-subdomain-pend: Someone has already asked for this address, and their request is still open.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-category-help: Used to list it in the wiki directory.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-wiki-purpose-l: A volunteer reads this before approving the wiki. Clear, specific descriptions get approved faster and rarely need a follow-up.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-reason-label: Describe the wiki's topic, scope and purpose
wikioasismagic-onboarding-reason-desc: Tap a prompt to add it as a starting point.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-reason-short: Add {{PLURAL:$1|$1 more character|$1 more characters}}. Reviewers need the topic, scope and who it's for.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-reason-require: Describe the wiki's topic, scope and purpose.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-duplicate-noti: '''Check it doesn't already exist.''' WikiOasis won't host a second wiki on the same subject as an existing one. If one exists but is inactive, you can ask to adopt it instead.

'''Check it doesn't already exist.''' WikiOasis won't host a second wiki on the same subject as an existing one, so [$1 search the wiki directory] first. If one exists but is inactive, you can ask to adopt it instead.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-wiki-settings-: Who can see it, and what's on it?
These help reviewers apply the right policies. Answer honestly; flagged topics are allowed, they just get the right settings.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-public-desc: Anyone can read it and search engines can index it.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-private-desc: Only administrators and people you allow can read it.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-bio-label: It's mainly about living people or real-life groups
wikioasismagic-onboarding-bio-desc: For example streamers, bands or a school. You'll need to follow the policy on covering real people.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-nsfw-label: It has content that isn't safe for work
wikioasismagic-onboarding-nsfw-desc: Graphic sex, gore or violence in text or media, or anything else unsuitable for under-18s.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-nsfw-primary-l: That content is the main focus of the wiki
wikioasismagic-onboarding-migrate-label: It's moving or forking from another wiki
wikioasismagic-onboarding-migrate-help: Once the wiki is approved, file a Request import on Meta with your XML dump and images and a volunteer will bring your pages over.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-wiki-review-le: This is what reviewers will see. You can't edit the request after sending it, but you can comment on it.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-flag-bio: About living people or real-life groups
wikioasismagic-onboarding-flag-nsfw-prim: Not safe for work (the main focus)
wikioasismagic-onboarding-err-language: Choose a language from the list.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-err-purpose: Choose what the wiki is for.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-err-toolong: That's too long. Keep it under {{PLURAL:$1|$1 character|$1 characters}}.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-err-sourceurl: Enter the full address, starting with https://
wikioasismagic-onboarding-err-policy: Confirm the wiki follows the Content Policy to send the request.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-err-network: Something went wrong reaching WikiOasis. Check your connection and try again.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-err-server: Something went wrong on WikiOasis's side ($1), so the request wasn't sent. Try again in a moment.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-done-lead: It's request $1 in the queue. You'll get a notification on Meta when a volunteer reviews it.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-done-lead-emai: It's request $1 in the queue. You'll get a notification on Meta and an email when a volunteer reviews it.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-done-noemail: We can't email you about this yet, so the decision will show up as a notification. If you'd like an email too, [[Special:Preferences#mw-prefsection-personal-email|add or confirm your email address]]. It's optional.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-timeline-revie: They check the description against the Content Policy and may leave a comment asking for more detail. Keep an eye on your notifications.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-timeline-live-: At $1, with you as its first bureaucrat.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-timeline-custo: Pick a skin, turn on extensions and set permissions in Special:ManageWiki.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-timeline-impor: File a Request import on Meta with your XML dump and images.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-timeline-domai: Point a CNAME at $1, then request it through Special:RequestSSL.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-preview-lead-e: Your description will start the Main Page.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-preview-note: Roughly how the wiki looks on day one. Skins, logo and colours are set in ManageWiki once it's live.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-survey-dropped: $1 was left out, because wikis can only be requested on the central wiki.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-survey-unknown: $1 refers to the question "$2", which this survey does not have.
$1 refers to the option "$2", which that question does not have.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-survey-save-in:
This survey can't be saved, because it would not be used:
$1
The format is described in [https://github.com/WikiOasis/WikiOasisMagic#onboarding the WikiOasisMagic documentation].
wikioasismagic-signup-lead: One account for all {{PLURAL:$1|$1 wiki|$1 wikis}} on WikiOasis, shared with {{PLURAL:$2|one other person|$2 other people}}.
wikioasismagic-signup-lead-nostats: One account for every wiki on WikiOasis.
wikioasismagic-signup-tabs-label: Log in or create an account
wikioasismagic-signup-email-help: Lets you reset your password and hear back about wiki requests.
wikioasismagic-editprompt-text: Spotted a typo or something missing? Anyone can help improve this wiki.
experiments-summary: Experiments roll features out to a share of wikis, users or browsers, and measure what happens. They are registered in $wgWikiOasisMagicExperiments; their rollout is managed here.
right-experiments-manage: View experiments and change their rollout
action-experiments-manage: view experiments and change their rollout
log-description-experiment: Changes to the rollout of experiments, made from [[Special:Experiments]].
apihelp-wikioasisexperiments-summary: Experiments and their results, for Special:Experiments.
apihelp-wikioasisexperiments-param-exper: Experiment name. Without it, every experiment is listed.
apihelp-wikioasisexperiments-param-prop: What to return for the experiment: <kbd>detail</kbd> for its configuration and rollout, <kbd>results</kbd> for what it has measured.
apihelp-wikioasisexperiments-param-days: Only count units first exposed in this many days; 0 for all of them.
apihelp-wikioasisexperimentsave-summary: Change the rollout of an experiment.
apihelp-wikioasisexperimentsave-param-st: JSON object of the fields to change: active, rollout, default, weights, population, start, end, wikis, excludeWikis.
apihelp-wikioasisexperimentsave-param-re: Drop every runtime change, so the experiment runs as configured.
apihelp-wikioasisexperimentevent-summary: Record a client-side event for the current user or browser in an experiment.
apihelp-wikioasisexperimentevent-param-m: Name of an event metric of the experiment that has "client" set.
wikioasismagic-experiment-signup-descrip: The redesigned Special:CreateAccount against the old one. Each browser is assigned once and keeps its screen.
wikioasismagic-experiment-onboarding-des: Whether new accounts are sent through Special:Welcome, which asks what they want to do and takes them there.
wikioasismagic-wikiprompt-text: Create a free wiki about anything you love — it only takes a few minutes.
wikioasismagic-experiments-error-badeven: That experiment has no event metric that can be recorded from the browser.
wikioasismagic-experiments-error-notcent: Experiments are changed on the central wiki.
wikioasismagic-experiments-error-unavail: The experiments tables could not be reached, so nothing was saved. Map virtual-wikioasismagic in $wgVirtualDomainsMapping and run update.php.
wikioasismagic-experiments-error-conflic: This experiment was changed by $1 after you opened it. Reload the page to see that change, then make yours again.
wikioasismagic-experiments-error-field: "$1" has a value that isn't allowed.
wikioasismagic-experiments-error-rollout: The share must be between 0 and 100%.
wikioasismagic-experiments-error-weights: Weights must be zero or more, and at least one must be more than zero.
wikioasismagic-experiments-error-dates: The end must be after the start.
wikioasismagic-experiments-error-wikis: Wiki lists can only hold database names, @central and @local.
wikioasismagic-experiments-empty: No experiments are registered yet. Add one to $wgWikiOasisMagicExperiments to manage its rollout here.
wikioasismagic-experiments-nojs: Changing rollouts and viewing results needs JavaScript.
wikioasismagic-experiments-population-wi: Only wikis created after the start.
Only wikis created before the start.
wikioasismagic-experiments-population-us: Anyone with an account, however old.
Only accounts registered after the start.
Only accounts registered before the start.
wikioasismagic-experiments-state-unavail: The experiments tables can't be reached, so every experiment runs exactly as configured and nothing can be changed. Map virtual-wikioasismagic in $wgVirtualDomainsMapping and run update.php.
wikioasismagic-experiments-manage-on-cen: Rollouts are changed on [$1 the central wiki], where every change is logged.
wikioasismagic-experiments-overrides: You're previewing $1 in this browser session. Previews are never counted.
wikioasismagic-experiments-tile-default-: Everyone outside the experiment gets this, and so does everyone once it stops.
wikioasismagic-experiments-changes-legac: The experience from before the experiment
wikioasismagic-experiments-changes-none: Nothing configured; code reads the variant
wikioasismagic-experiments-preview-help: Preview links force a variant for your browser session only. Previews are never counted.
wikioasismagic-experiments-metrics-none: This experiment doesn't measure anything yet. Add metrics to its configuration.
wikioasismagic-experiments-metric-event: Counted by the feature's own code
wikioasismagic-experiments-metric-event-: Counted in the browser by the feature
wikioasismagic-experiments-window: Events count for $1 {{PLURAL:$2|day|days}} after a unit gets its variant.
wikioasismagic-experiments-window-none: Events count for as long as the experiment runs.
wikioasismagic-experiments-salt-help: Assignment is a hash of the salt and the unit, so it is the same on every wiki and needs no storage. Changing the salt in configuration reshuffles everyone.
wikioasismagic-experiments-readonly-cent: Rollouts are changed on [$1 the central wiki].
wikioasismagic-experiments-readonly-unav: Changes can't be saved because the experiments tables can't be reached.
wikioasismagic-experiments-edit-active-h: While it's off, nobody is enrolled and everyone gets $1. Results stay as they were.
wikioasismagic-experiments-edit-rollout-: Raising it only adds units; nobody already enrolled moves to another variant.
wikioasismagic-experiments-ship-help: Ship makes a variant the default and stops the experiment, so everyone gets it.
wikioasismagic-experiments-field-start-h: UTC. Empty starts straight away. New and existing are counted from here.
wikioasismagic-experiments-field-end-hel: UTC. Empty runs until it's switched off.
wikioasismagic-experiments-field-wikis-h: Database names, @central or @local. Empty means every wiki can be enrolled.
Wikis the experiment runs on: database names, @central or @local. Empty means every wiki.
Wikis the experiment runs on: database names, @central or @local. Empty means every wiki.
wikioasismagic-experiments-field-exclude: Takes priority over the list above.
wikioasismagic-experiments-reset-confirm: Every change made here is dropped and the experiment runs exactly as configured.
wikioasismagic-experiments-warning-weigh: Changing weights moves some enrolled units to another variant. They start over in their new group.
wikioasismagic-experiments-warning-rampd: Lowering the share takes units out of the experiment. They get the default variant, and start over if they come back.
wikioasismagic-experiments-warning-popul: Units that no longer qualify get the default variant.
wikioasismagic-experiments-warning-stop: Stopping gives everyone the default variant and freezes the results.
wikioasismagic-experiments-warning-start: The start is set to now, because new and existing are counted from it.
wikioasismagic-experiments-warning-wikis: Wikis whose variant changes get its extensions switched on or off through ManageWiki, and their configuration rebuilt. Across the farm this takes a few minutes.
wikioasismagic-experiments-warning-reset: Wikis, users and browsers may move to another variant.
wikioasismagic-experiments-saved: Saved. Every wiki picks the change up within a few minutes.
wikioasismagic-experiments-saved-wikis: Saved. Wikis are being updated in the background, which takes a few minutes.
wikioasismagic-experiments-period-7: First counted in the last 7 days
wikioasismagic-experiments-period-30: First counted in the last 30 days
wikioasismagic-experiments-period-90: First counted in the last 90 days
wikioasismagic-experiments-data-unavaila: Results can't be shown because the experiments tables can't be reached.
wikioasismagic-experiments-results-empty: Nothing measured yet. Wikis are counted once they get a variant while the experiment runs.
Nothing measured yet. Users are counted when they first see their variant while the experiment runs.
Nothing measured yet. Browsers are counted when they first see their variant while the experiment runs.
wikioasismagic-experiments-results-ineli: $1 {{PLURAL:$2|wiki was|wikis were}} left out because {{PLURAL:$2|it|they}} had already chosen what this experiment changes.
wikioasismagic-experiments-results-srm: The split doesn't match the weights (p $1). If the weights changed while the experiment ran, that is expected; otherwise units are being assigned or counted unevenly somewhere, so treat these results with care.
wikioasismagic-experiments-results-summa: Share of units that did it at least once. Changes are relative to $1; green is better and orange is worse, at 95% confidence.
wikioasismagic-experiments-interval: 95% confidence interval for the difference: $1 to $2
wikioasismagic-experiments-chart-adoptio: Share of units that did "$1", over time
wikioasismagic-experiments-results-help: Rates count units that did something at least once, out of those counted. Units outside the experiment are shown for reference only. Bots and previews are never counted.
wikioasismagic-experiments-history-empty: No changes yet: the experiment runs as configured.
wikioasismagic-experiments-history-faile: The history could not be loaded ($1).
wikioasismagic-experiments-extension-wik: This experiment has switched its extensions on through ManageWiki on $1 {{PLURAL:$2|wiki|wikis}}. A wiki that switches one off again has opted out and is left alone.
wikioasismagic-onboarding-api-disabled: The new onboarding is switched off on this wiki.
apihelp-wikioasisexperimentsave-param-ba: The version of the state the change is based on (lastChange.version from action=wikioasisexperiments), or empty if it was never changed, so conflicting changes are refused.
wikioasismagic-experiments-error-conflic: This experiment was reset to its configuration after you opened it. Reload the page to see that, then make your change again.
wikioasismagic-experiments-extension-man: Switched on and off through ManageWiki, which creates any tables it needs.
wikioasismagic-experiments-history-centr: The history is kept on [$1 the central wiki].
